evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is granted authority to impose a role obligation — enrollment as reviewer — on the creator, enacting a rule-governed hierarchy where the system ranks the participant into a duty.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle subordinate to the suite's assertion — its existence is justified by carrying the rule, reinforcing the authority-ranking move that the system's assertion governs the participant's role.
